description: Host-independent protocol-object vectors for v1 relative paths and manifests. No vector names or inspects a local filesystem path.

cases.name: legal_files_directories_empty_and_nested
cases.description: Files, directories, an empty file, and directory ancestors form a legal manifest.

cases.name: legal_posix_case_distinct_paths
cases.description: The explicit POSIX fixture profile treats ASCII case variants as distinct.

cases.name: legal_nfc_compatibility_distinct_paths
cases.description: NFC does not apply compatibility folding: ASCII A and fullwidth A remain distinct.

cases.name: legal_exact_path_and_component_byte_limits
cases.description: A generated 1024-byte path uses legal components including a 255-byte component.

cases.name: legal_exact_component_count_limit
cases.description: A relative path may contain exactly 32 nonempty components.

cases.name: legal_exact_file_total_and_commitment_limits
cases.description: One 16 TiB file and 64-byte commitments exercise exact maxima.

cases.name: legal_exact_manifest_entry_count_limit
cases.description: A deterministic generated series contains exactly 100000 directory entries.

cases.name: legal_exact_aggregate_path_bytes_limit
cases.description: 32768 generated paths of 1024 bytes total exactly 33554432 encoded bytes.

cases.name: hostile_empty_path
cases.description: An empty relative path is not a legal entry name.

cases.name: hostile_posix_absolute_path
cases.description: A leading slash is an absolute path marker.

cases.name: hostile_slash_unc_path
cases.description: A slash-form UNC path is never a wire-relative path.

cases.name: hostile_backslash_unc_path
cases.description: A backslash-form UNC path is rejected without host path parsing.

cases.name: hostile_windows_drive_absolute_path
cases.description: A drive-rooted path is not relative.

cases.name: hostile_windows_drive_qualified_path
cases.description: A drive-relative form is also drive-qualified and prohibited.

cases.name: hostile_leading_parent_traversal
cases.description: A parent component cannot escape a destination root.

cases.name: hostile_embedded_parent_traversal
cases.description: Traversal remains invalid when embedded below a component.

cases.name: hostile_dot_component
cases.description: Dot components are not canonical wire paths.

cases.name: hostile_empty_component
cases.description: Repeated slash separators create an empty component.

cases.name: hostile_trailing_separator
cases.description: A trailing slash is prohibited.

cases.name: hostile_backslash_separator
cases.description: Backslash is data-hostile and never a v1 wire separator.

cases.name: hostile_windows_alternate_data_stream
cases.description: Colon cannot encode a Windows alternate data stream.

cases.name: hostile_invalid_utf8_continuation
cases.description: Raw path bytes with an isolated continuation octet are malformed UTF-8.

cases.name: hostile_overlong_utf8
cases.description: An overlong slash encoding is not shortest-form UTF-8.

cases.name: hostile_utf8_surrogate
cases.description: A UTF-8 encoding of a surrogate code point is invalid.

cases.name: hostile_nul_path
cases.description: U+0000 is explicitly prohibited in UTF-8 paths.

cases.name: hostile_c0_control
cases.description: C0 controls are prohibited in paths.

cases.name: hostile_c1_control
cases.description: C1 controls are prohibited in paths.

cases.name: hostile_unicode_noncharacter
cases.description: Unicode noncharacters cannot appear in path text.

cases.name: hostile_non_nfc_normalization_collision_attempt
cases.description: A decomposed spelling that would normalize onto an earlier path is rejected before collision comparison.

cases.name: hostile_relative_path_byte_limit_plus_one
cases.description: A generated 1025-byte path exceeds the hard limit by one.

cases.name: hostile_component_byte_limit_plus_one
cases.description: One 256-byte component exceeds its hard limit by one.

cases.name: hostile_component_count_limit_plus_one
cases.description: A path with 33 components exceeds the hard limit by one.

cases.name: hostile_exact_duplicate_path
cases.description: Two entries cannot name the same canonical path.

cases.name: hostile_windows_ascii_case_collision
cases.description: ASCII case variants collide under the explicit Windows fixture profile.

cases.name: hostile_file_ancestor_before_descendant
cases.description: A file cannot already occupy an ancestor of a later entry.

cases.name: hostile_file_ancestor_after_descendant
cases.description: A later file cannot replace the ancestor directory implied by an earlier entry.

cases.name: hostile_windows_casefolded_file_ancestor
cases.description: Ancestor checks use the same target comparison profile as duplicate checks.

cases.name: hostile_offer_zero_entries
cases.description: A v1 transfer offer must advertise at least one entry.

cases.name: hostile_offer_entry_count_limit_plus_one
cases.description: An offer cannot advertise more than 100000 entries.

cases.name: hostile_offer_entry_count_u32_overflow
cases.description: A logical offer value outside U32 cannot represent the wire field.

cases.name: hostile_offer_total_file_bytes_limit_plus_one
cases.description: An offer total cannot exceed 16 TiB.

cases.name: hostile_offer_total_u64_overflow
cases.description: A logical offer total outside U64 cannot represent the wire field.

cases.name: hostile_offer_commitment_too_short
cases.description: A manifest commitment shorter than 16 bytes is invalid.

cases.name: hostile_symlink_kind_representation
cases.description: An attempted symlink kind is outside the file/directory registry.

cases.name: hostile_hard_link_kind_representation
cases.description: An attempted hard-link kind is outside the file/directory registry.

cases.name: hostile_device_kind_representation
cases.description: An attempted device kind is outside the file/directory registry.

cases.name: hostile_socket_kind_representation
cases.description: An attempted socket kind is outside the file/directory registry.

cases.name: hostile_file_without_commitment
cases.description: Every file entry requires a commitment.

cases.name: hostile_file_commitment_too_short
cases.description: A file commitment shorter than 16 bytes is invalid.

cases.name: hostile_directory_with_commitment
cases.description: A directory cannot carry a file commitment.

cases.name: hostile_directory_with_nonzero_size
cases.description: A directory file_size must be zero.

cases.name: hostile_file_size_limit_plus_one
cases.description: One file cannot exceed 16 TiB.

cases.name: hostile_file_size_u64_overflow
cases.description: A logical file size outside U64 cannot represent the wire field.

cases.name: hostile_noncontiguous_entry_index
cases.description: Manifest indexes must start at zero and remain contiguous.

cases.name: hostile_duplicate_entry_index
cases.description: Repeating an earlier index violates contiguous ordering.

cases.name: hostile_entry_transfer_id_mismatch
cases.description: Every entry remains bound to the offer transfer ID.

cases.name: hostile_incremental_manifest_entry_count_limit
cases.description: The receiver rejects the 100001st observed entry before MANIFEST_END.

cases.name: hostile_incremental_aggregate_path_limit_plus_one
cases.description: A final one-byte path pushes the checked aggregate above 33554432.

cases.name: hostile_incremental_total_file_bytes_limit_plus_one
cases.description: Two individually legal files produce a checked total one byte above 16 TiB.

cases.name: hostile_offer_entry_count_summary_mismatch
cases.description: The observed count must equal the offer count.

cases.name: hostile_end_entry_count_summary_mismatch
cases.description: MANIFEST_END must repeat the exact observed count.

cases.name: hostile_offer_total_summary_mismatch
cases.description: The checked file byte sum must equal the offer total.

cases.name: hostile_end_total_summary_mismatch
cases.description: MANIFEST_END must repeat the exact checked file byte sum.

cases.name: hostile_manifest_commitment_summary_mismatch
cases.description: MANIFEST_END commitment must exactly equal the offer commitment.

cases.name: hostile_end_transfer_id_mismatch
cases.description: MANIFEST_END remains bound to the offer transfer ID.

cases.name: hostile_missing_manifest_end
cases.description: The manifest object must terminate with MANIFEST_END.

cases.name: hostile_windows_reserved_device
cases.description: A Windows reserved device name is not a portable path component.

cases.name: hostile_windows_reserved_device_extension
cases.description: A reserved device alias remains reserved with an extension and mixed ASCII case.

cases.name: hostile_windows_trailing_dot
cases.description: A component ending in an ASCII dot is not portable to Windows.

cases.name: hostile_windows_trailing_space
cases.description: A component ending in an ASCII space is not portable to Windows.
